title: On this day in space! Oct. 26, 2004: Cassini spacecraft takes 1st-ever closeup photos of Saturn moon Titan
caption:
In 2004, NASA's Cassini spacecraft gave us our first clear look at Saturn's largest moon, Titan. The images revealed a mysterious world that looked hauntingly like a younger version of Earth.

Source: Space - On this day in space! Oct. 26, 2004: Cassini spacecraft takes 1st-ever closeup photos of Saturn moon Titan
